title: A Weird Al-themed IDE joins Hack-&-Build
summary:
Two community coding projects joined the lists, while model labels and pricing metadata got a tidy-up.

YankoviC was added to the Hack-&-Build project list. Its Accordion IDE uses Pollinations for tab autocomplete and chat assistance while people learn the language.

PairFusion was added to the Vibe Coding project list, with links to its demo and repository. It pairs a collaborative IDE with AI-assisted feedback.

The model list now labels `openai` as GPT-4o Mini and `openai-audio` as GPT-4o Mini Audio Preview. Pricing metadata was also revised across several models.
